preregistration: Observability test — is opponent-conditional demand reachable from legal context?
ordering_evidence: the C5 discovery scan was still running when this file was written; see artifacts/c5_discovery/C5_RESULT.json mtime vs this commit
applies_if: C5_PASS (discovery AND confirmation). On C5_NO_REVERSAL this test is not run and this file stands only as ordering evidence.

why_this_gate_exists.what_c5_can_establish: that a response tradeoff EXISTS across opponents
why_this_gate_exists.what_c5_cannot_establish: that anything a deployed agent can legally observe predicts which side of the tradeoff it is on
why_this_gate_exists.the_failure_this_prevents: training O4 and a router on demand that is real but invisible. The router sees legal_context only -- never opponent identity -- so unroutable demand yields a router that cannot beat picking one policy, and K=2 collapses to K=1 at deployment.
why_this_gate_exists.why_it_runs_BEFORE_oracle_training: this is a property of the world and the observation space, not of any trained policy. It is answerable with frozen G0 policies for a fraction of one PPO run, and a negative answer makes the PPO run pointless. O3 cost a full training run to learn something a cheaper test could have shown.

oracle_selector.behaviour: in every state, plays whichever member of the C5-confirmed response pair is better AGAINST THAT OPPONENT, using the direction confirmed by C5
oracle_selector.role: upper bound on what the tradeoff is worth to anyone
oracle_selector.note: not deployable -- opponent identity remains prohibited as a policy or router input

legal_selector.sees: the legal_context feature vector ONLY, exactly the fields run_g0_v2_evaluation.legal_context exposes
legal_selector.behaviour: predicts the reversal direction from legal_context, then plays the response that prediction favours
legal_selector.model_class: L2 logistic regression, C=1.0, no hyperparameter search
legal_selector.why_frozen_and_simple: an open model search would rediscover the multiplicity problem, and a tuned selector's gain would not be an honest estimate of what a router could learn
legal_selector.fit_on: states from the C5 discovery block 9840000-9840029
legal_selector.evaluated_on: the fresh block below, out of sample, never on its fitting data

baseline.definition: the single fixed response from the confirmed pair with the higher pooled mean utility across all opponents
baseline.why_this_baseline: it is what K=1 already does. A selector must beat the best single response, not the worse one -- beating the worse one measures nothing.

seeds.rule: run ONCE, evaluation only, no refitting after seeing the result

statistics.inherited_from: the C4/C5 contract, not newly chosen

ROUTABLE.condition: oracle_gain LCB95 > 0 AND legal_gain LCB95 > 0 AND recovery_ratio >= 0.50
ROUTABLE.establishes: the tradeoff exists AND a legal observer recovers at least half of it
ROUTABLE.authorizes: freezing an O4 precursor derived from the legal_selector's decision boundary, then O4 training
ROUTABLE.does_not_authorize: skipping the O4 precursor firing-rate requirement inherited from C4 -- O3 fired in 99.98% of episodes and must not recur

UNROUTABLE.condition: oracle_gain LCB95 > 0 but legal_gain LCB95 <= 0 or recovery_ratio < 0.50
UNROUTABLE.meaning: the demand is REAL but INVISIBLE from legal context on this map
UNROUTABLE.action: STOP. Do not train O4 and do not add features to legal_context to make it visible -- that would be choosing the observation space to fit a hoped-for result. The legitimate route is a preregistered change to the OBSERVATION SPACE justified independently of this tradeoff, or new strategic demand designed to be observable from the start.
UNROUTABLE.recorded_as: a genuine finding about map_a, not a failed experiment

NO_DEMAND_IN_BLOCK.meaning: the C5-confirmed tradeoff did not reproduce on this third block
NO_DEMAND_IN_BLOCK.action: treat the C5 pass as unreplicated and STOP. Do not reselect a different response pair.

the_0_50_bar.rationale: a router that recovers under half the available gain is unlikely to repay a second policy's cost, given that every prior gate in this project was cleared or failed by margins far larger than measurement noise
the_0_50_bar.explicitly_not: a bar chosen to be clearable by whatever number appears

prohibited: using opponent identity in the legal_selector
searching model classes or hyperparameters after seeing the recovery ratio
adding fields to legal_context to raise the recovery ratio
refitting the legal_selector on the evaluation block
training O4 on an UNROUTABLE or NO_DEMAND_IN_BLOCK result
claiming a task-outcome result from a carrier_survival screen proxy
immutability: After any number from the evaluation block exists, none of the above may change.
